**What camera are you looking to add?*
Please include the manufacture and full model of the camera. [e.g. Sony PXW-FX9]

**What codec(s) does the camera record in?**
Please list the camera's supported codecs. [e.g. XAVC-I, ProRes 422]

**What resolution(s) does the camera record in, and at what bitrate(s)?**
Please list the camera's supported recording resolutions. [e.g. 3840x2106@240Mbps, 1920x1080@89Mbps]

**What framerate(s) does the camera record in?**
Please list the camera's supported recording frame rates. [e.g. 23.98, 25, 29.97, 60, 120]

**Can you provide a link to the manual for the camera or a codec breakdown from the manufacture?**

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
